audience: Shopify merchants who collect product and store reviews with Loox

useCases.title: Find products with 1 and 2 star reviews
useCases.text: The AI lists published reviews with 1 or 2 stars in a date range and reads the review text, product and merchant reply. You see which products get complaints and what they say.

useCases.title: Check reviews waiting for approval
useCases.text: The AI lists reviews with the pending status and shows rating, text and product for each one. You can see what is waiting and what needs a decision.

useCases.title: Summarize what customers praise and dislike
useCases.text: The AI reads review text, photo reviews and AI highlights for one product or the whole store. It sums up common praise and complaints.

useCases.title: Compare the rating of products and the store
useCases.text: The AI gets the review count and average stars of single products, plus the count per star for all product reviews. You can compare products and spot weak ones.

useCases.title: Read store reviews about your shop
useCases.text: The AI reads store-level reviews (about the shop, not one product) by star rating and date. It shows the average, the count per star and the main themes.
